title: Put two swatches on a friction sled
description: Use the native sliding fixture to show retained normal and tangential reactions and the stick-to-slip transition between two synthetic surface states. Render the sled path from recorded samples.
acceptance_criteria: Each control must select a declared load history and original reaction curve. Keep missing source-qualified coefficients unavailable. Verify motion direction, units and threshold against the native report.
close_reason: Verified /experiments/friction/ with native ftx-drape sliding-sled report (report_sha256 3f49ba86937ef076, 4 declared load histories across synthetic mu=0.40 & mu=0.75, 0/449 catalog friction pairs explicitly unavailable), live WASM material_calibrate_friction + CLI parity, friction-sled.test.mjs 2/2 PASS, 4 screenshots visually verified, UBS 0 critical, rustfmt clean.

title: Measure how elastic holds the waistband
description: Solve the same seven-piece trouser with different casing axial stiffness, show end-state drift and native strain, and provide a matched-camera film of the result.
acceptance_criteria: Compare 5, 15, 30 and 60 N to their reports. Show the 0 N refusal with no substitute cloth mesh or numeric garment result. Keep the casing law distinct from a measured elastic.
close_reason: Four stiffness endpoints and the zero-stiffness refusal are visible with the A4 pattern and a matched-camera film.

title: Build a thermal sandwich from measured sheets
description: Expose the steady conduction consumer as an explodable 3D layer stack. Start with a measured sheet, add another layer at an explicit interface resistance, and change the two boundary temperatures. Keep the source, units and layer-by-layer temperature drops visible.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce the native measured-neoprene steady fixture. Match both surface temperatures and heat flux for one and two layers. A missing interface value blocks the layered case. Do not infer comfort, pressure effects or storage.
close_reason: Live WASM steady-conduction exhibit at /experiments/thermal/ verified against native measured neoprene/leather single- and two-layer fixtures, reversed gradient, missing-interface refusal, and engine-failure recovery in thermal-sandwich.test.mjs.

title: Wash, shrink and recut a garment
description: Use a documented treatment and conditions from ftx-care1 to show warp/weft shrinkage against the original cutting outline. Offer only measured combinations supported by the same material revision.
acceptance_criteria: Maintain units and grain orientation. Show source and residuals; unsupported material/treatment pairs stay unavailable. Verify the revised SVG against the treatment output.
close_reason: Live WASM Kanat & Ozdil (2026) ISO 6330 shrinkage and pre-wash compensation exhibit at /experiments/wash/ verified byte-for-byte against native ftx materials treatment-pattern and ftx export all (SVG + A4 PDF), with unsupported cotton muslin refusal and mobile checks in wash-shrink.test.mjs.

title: Find and repair a mismatched seam
description: Pair a front and back sewing edge, walk their actual arc lengths, then apply the existing alteration and repeat the native check. This makes a failed pre-cut check actionable.
acceptance_criteria: Use a reversible synthetic alteration on a named seam and distinguish seam allowance from the sewing line. Verify the original, broken and repaired reports and full-size output against the CLI.
close_reason: Live WASM seam repair studio at /sections/repair/ verified across original, broken (+20 mm hem drop), and trued stages against native CLI reports and full-size SVG/A4 PDF output in seam-repair.test.mjs.

title: Compare two native drapes of one fixed dress
description: Put independently accepted states from two synthetic adult forms next to each other under one camera and scale. Make changes in hem position and geometric clearance visible. Configure the solver and mesh identically and surface flags and refusals for either side.
acceptance_criteria: Swapping sides preserves each report and common world scale. The same state on both sides matches. A refused solve cannot appear as a completed garment.

title: Redraft a sundress after an ease warning
description: After a fixed dress reports insufficient bust or waist ease, let the visitor request a second checked pattern. Pin both silhouettes and compare how much each seam and panel moved. Always preserve the first draft and its export names.
acceptance_criteria: An unchanged request gives matching outlines. An increase in required bust ease changes the export and recalculates seam lengths. Prevent downloads from a stale result.
close_reason: Shipped /wardrobe/sundress/redraft/ using live Rust/WASM alter_pattern and run. Preserves fixed GARDEN_SUNDRESS_A4.pdf/master_mm.svg untouched, emits SUNDRESS_REDRAFT exports only after fresh verification, locks downloads whenever inputs are stale, pins 1:1 silhouettes, recalculates all 8 seams, and passes sundress-redraft.test.mjs (2/2 including native ftx validate parity and 390px phone checks).

title: Compare warp, weft and bias in one pull
description: Expose the existing clamped-strip experiment (see ftx-ki1) through three specimens of identical material and dimensions. Keep the same axes, scale and pull for all three. Visitors can see why the grain of the pattern piece matters.
acceptance_criteria: At 8% extension, each force and mid-width equals its corresponding native report. Return to zero, orbit with keys, switch mesh, and play the standalone render.
close_reason: Native strip run at 8 percent produced warp 1.631 N, weft 0.978 N and bias 1.041 N. All three reports, the step controls and the film are available in the exhibit.

title: A layered 1761 Swedish hussar uniform
description: Compare the two source-documented Swedish hussar configurations. Let visitors lift the pelisse, inspect the braid and cuffs, and take away a real example of the braid machine file. Attach collection evidence and describe original reconstructed geometry.
acceptance_criteria: Change regiment, isolate a garment and inspect the braid. Verify the downloadable DST and associated source pattern. Verify the film and its poster show the actual 3D exhibit.
close_reason: Both 1761 regiments, pelisse and dolman views, and shared 155-record native braid sampler verified through the served wardrobe exhibit.

title: Trace one embroidery stitch onto the hussar dolman
description: Connect the real DST placement and tack runs to the displayed garment through registered panel coordinates. Let the visitor pause at the braid stop and orbit the matching embroidery on the chest.
acceptance_criteria: Require a panel-to-surface correspondence and validate multiple registered needle positions within a stated render tolerance. Leave unmatched segments on the flat sample. Link the original DST and corresponding pattern PDF.
close_reason: Live at /wardrobe/hussar/embroidery/ in ftx-ldxi. Both served DSTs match native exports byte for byte. Verified 2,172 registered stitches per front within the 0.25 mm flat registration tolerance, the braid stop, flat-only travel and unregistered sampler, and the linked pattern PDF.

title: Compare the sleeve with an arm raised
description: Use an identical sleeve pattern on the same synthetic body in two articulated poses. Replay the independently solved armscye and cuff geometry side by side to explain what pattern ease can and cannot show.
acceptance_criteria: Compare the same mesh and material in each pose. Publish native cuff positions, spread and any contact flags. Geometric changes remain distinct from physical comfort.
close_reason: Drape room links nine native arm and chest runs, a force map, flags and a pose comparison film.

title: Play the actual sewing order on a jacket
description: Use accepted steps from the sewing planner (ftx-sp1) to light each operation on the flat pattern and matching garment panel. Opening a seam’s operation should show its next dependencies and physical endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: The operation count and ordering agree with the same native job. Keyboard next/previous and the machine-file link work even on a phone.
close_reason: Synchronized flat-pattern and 3D bolero sewing-order player at /studies/sewing/ verified against native ftx-materials sew-plan and sew-stitches (10 operations, 734 directed stitches, 73.68 s feed), with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigation, prerequisite/unlocked dependency chips, and phone downloads in sewing-order.test.mjs.

title: Cut a second garment from the real remnant
description: Take the cutting marker’s residual stock into a second job using the existing remnant planner (ftx-tm7.10). Overlay original cutouts, surviving usable stock and the second garment to explain the fabric savings.
acceptance_criteria: Use the returned stock identifiers and actual occupied polygons. The second job cannot cut inside the first garment or silently assume a fresh roll.
close_reason: Delivered through ftx-83qx and ftx-2vij at /sections/cut/?mode=remnant. Live Chromium and native replay rechecked preserved stock IDs, locked first-job cutouts, positive second cuts, explicit refusal and the updated receipt. Drafts retain their exact pattern and PDF when passed into the demo.

title: Follow one flat panel through a sewn garment
description: Map a panel’s original exterior mesh edges to its colored vertices in the native replay. A small flat outline stays visible while that panel moves from the board into the sleeve or trouser leg. Reuse the native index ranges and viewer.
acceptance_criteria: Inspect left and right pieces on each garment. The outline is bounded in board coordinates, selection persists while scrubbing, and seam and strain views keep their original colors when selection is cleared.
close_reason: Browser verified the flat boundary of each of five bolero panels and seven trouser panels. Scrubbing and switching from panel focus to seam focus passed.

title: A fixed sundress on a posable adult dress form
description: Present the same four-panel sundress as visitors change adult stature, bust and waist or pose an arm. Keep the cut dimensions fixed. Report signed ease against the checked master, coordinate with native exports, and identify which geometry is an interactive study versus a settled solve.
acceptance_criteria: At reference and close/full presets, compare displayed ease to the native flat report. Drag each wrist and use the keyboard equivalents. Open both printable files; verify a cold mobile load.
close_reason: Fixed four-panel cut, live articulating adult form, native signed ease at all three profiles, eight trued joins, PDF and film verified. Native drape sewing limit is published.

title: A wrap skirt with adjustable overlap
description: Add a wrap-skirt pattern with waist ties and demonstrate how much fabric overlaps at the front. Allow the wearer form to change while the chosen skirt stays fixed, and let visitors compare a second tie setting.
acceptance_criteria: Check wrap edges and requested tie placements against flat pattern lengths. Print the actual outline and compare neutral and seated synthetic examples, showing any limits explicitly.
close_reason: Verified /studies/wrap-skirt/ with fixed trued WRAP_SKIRT pattern passing native ftx validate CONVERGED (7/7 seams 0.0 mm residual, 4/4 truing corners PASS), native Anny 0.6.1 neutral vs seated slices across 3 synthetic adult forms, Setting A vs B tie comparison, native A4 PDF & master SVG exports, wrap-skirt.test.mjs 2/2 PASS, 3 screenshots visually verified, UBS 0 critical.

title: Try standing, seated and squat trouser forms
description: Keep the Anny tape targets, flat cut, material inputs and arm pose fixed. Compare independently sewn bent forms with refused deep poses on the lower display form.
acceptance_criteria: Both shallow bends must replay their own endpoints and flags. Full seat and squat show only the requested native form and diagnostic. Verify diagnostic, garment downloads and camera on a phone.
close_reason: Two shallow bends and three distinct postures verified against the native results and refusal branches in trouser-study.test.mjs.

title: Cut and sew an eighteenth-century waistcoat
description: Build an adult waistcoat around a documented collection object. Separate fronts, lining and pocket welts; show how the flat welt opening becomes a visible garment detail. Attach collection provenance to the reconstruction.
acceptance_criteria: Select both a front and a pocket. Each links to the correct cut-piece outline and sewing landmarks. The SVG opens at the published dimensions.
close_reason: Verified /wardrobe/waistcoat/ reconstructed from Victoria and Albert Museum 256-1880 (O112019, 1780s; chest 107.5 cm, front 69 cm, back 67 cm). Native ftx validate CONVERGED (36/36 seams 0.0 mm residual, 3/3 truing PASS), separate fronts/facing/lining/pocket welts & bags, 4-stage flat-slash-to-visible welt transformation, native master SVG opening at published 1139.12mm x 1570.648mm, waistcoat.test.mjs 2/2 PASS, screenshots verified, UBS 0 critical.

title: Slice a draped trouser leg at the cutting table
description: At any height compare body and cloth contours from the same posed triangles. A scale drawing and optional clipped 3D view let visitors see where the fullness goes.
acceptance_criteria: At 280 mm compare standing and two shallow bends to independently intersected native OBJ geometry within 0.25 mm. At 100 mm only the body intersects. Keep the matching A4 PDF beside the controls.
close_reason: Matched native mesh cross sections at 100 and 280 mm and verified the camera plane, empty-cloth case, and cutaway in Chromium.

title: Let a vision agent trace a drape pixel to the flat pattern and test its revision
description: Use the native still camera and saved panel map to identify a visible garment instance, then run and compare an agent-chosen edit in an immutable round.
close_reason: Located a cuff on a native PNG, reviewed the 50 mm shorter sleeve in a separate simulation, published both views and the seven-page checked pattern.

title: Assemble an A4 sewing pattern on screen
description: Put a real tiled export on a virtual floor. Visitors can turn alignment crosses on, compare the tiled boundary with the full master and download the same PDF. This answers a practical first-time printing question.
acceptance_criteria: Page count and overlap derive from the exported PDF. At full scale its scale bar matches the master and the guides remain legible at mobile width.
close_reason: Virtual A4 pattern assembly floor at /studies/tiling/ parses actual exported PDF streams live (page counts, 190x277 mm frames, 5 mm bleed overlap, omitted blank tiles, join codes, 100 mm scale bar), verifies master comparison, exact PDF download, and 390 px mobile legibility in tile-floor.test.mjs.

title: Twist and compress a cloth cylinder
description: Stage the existing cylinder experiment (see ftx-tm2.1) between graduated holders. Tie the time cursor, rotation, axial force, torque and gap-limit feedback to a single accepted state. Keep the slip flags and protocol discrepancies visible.
acceptance_criteria: Compare mounted, twisted, compressed and final-pull values with the included source report. Run tests for keyboard, film fallback, render decode and negative force.
close_reason: Published all 29 native cylinder states with geometry, upper reactions, force-limit flags, deviations, residuals and a seven-second WebGL capture.

title: Show the dressed squat, coupled outfit and actual material loads
description: Show accepted clothed native poses, a true inter-garment contact replay, and refined tensile and cylinder runs with measured jersey observations beside the simulated reactions.
close_reason: Verified dressed quarter squat, jointly settled outfit, contact-enabled compression tube, native strip equilibria and measured jersey readouts in the production browser.

title: Turn a lined jacket inside out
description: Expose the facing, shell and lining of one specifically documented garment. Rotate them together and select a construction edge to see where corresponding layers join. Use matching actual panel and seam IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Toggling the shell reveals the correct lining; turning layers apart does not change their seam indices. Surface any missing lining or unpaired seam without inventing one.
close_reason: Verified /wardrobe/waistcoat/inside-out/ exposing shell, plain silk facing, linen lining, and pocket bags of V&A 256-1880 on a synchronized Three.js rotatable 3D stage. Toggling shell reveals lining, separating layers preserves all 36 0-based native seam indices (0..35) with radial correspondence highlights, and missing collar lining (7 edges), open back vent (8 edges), and internal slash joins (8 edges) are surfaced without inventing one. inside-out.test.mjs 2/2 PASS, 3D screenshots verified, UBS 0 critical.

title: Cut and true both skirts on the fitted adult waist and high hip
description: Compare successive native drapes to the fitted torso. Publish each accepted size with its source, actual A4 pattern and shared-plane waist section.
close_reason: Re-cut and trued both six-gore skirts for six fitted waists. Reviewed the worn cuts from three angles and corrected the pinched hem on the 65 cm column. Each accepted drape has the checked A4 pattern and a common-plane waist section.

title: Show the actual flat pieces becoming the sewn garment throughout the exhibition
description: Restore board and wrapping frames. Render the component pieces, sewing and drape of the public garments, and expose these stages directly in the garment studies.
close_reason: Ten chaptered construction films, native cut and sewing replays, the two-cut sundress with measured waist sections and true-scale PDFs, and all 49 uniform templates per regiment are live on the requested domain.

title: Keep exhibited sewing panels disjoint during placement and native drape
description: Correct the board-to-body display paths and point-cache playback that let separate fabric panels cross. Re-run the dolman with self-contact, and verify the geometry and the published films.
close_reason: Disjoint panel staging, contact-protected drapes and exact replays. Repaired gathered dress; guard checks every archived physics frame against the full body. Bolero studies begin at the checked first sewing state.
